topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution and Microenvironment
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the learning objectives and framing cancer development as an evolutionary process influenced by the microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic Clonal Selection and Epigenetic Alterations in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops through genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations that confer selective growth advantages to expanding clones.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the role of normal tissue hierarchies and stemness properties in determining the cell of origin and tumor propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion, Inflammation, and Stromal Support
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how inflammatory microenvironments and stromal interactions promote tumor initiation, outgrowth, and therapeutic dependency.

topics.label: Technologies for Profiling Tumor Evolution and Spatial Architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the genomic, transcriptomic, and spatial profiling technologies used to investigate tumor evolution and cellular interactions in tissues.

topics.label: Evolutionary Synthesis of Multistep Cancer Development
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides an integrated synthesis of how genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors converge to drive cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with closing remarks and a preview of the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
